headword: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}

definitions.explanation: A planned area where factories and related facilities are gathered together, typically developed with shared infrastructure such as roads and utilities.

examples.japanese: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}に{工場|こうじょう}を{建|た}てる。
examples.english: to build a factory in an industrial park

examples.japanese: {市|し}は{郊外|こうがい}に{工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}を{造成|ぞうせい}した。
examples.english: The city developed an industrial park in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}には{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{集|あつ}まり、{地域|ちいき}の{雇用|こよう}を{支|ささ}えている。
examples.english: Many companies have gathered in the industrial park, supporting local employment.

notes:
A developed zone where industrial plants are concentrated. Built from {工業|こうぎょう} (industry) and {団地|だんち} (a planned cluster of buildings or housing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}を{造成|ぞうせい}する: to develop an industrial park
- {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}に{進出|しんしゅつ}する: for a company to move into an industrial park

RELATED WORDS:
- {団地|だんち}: a planned housing or building complex
- {工場地帯|こうじょうちたい}: factory zone; industrial belt
